card.name: Words right before explosion terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and partial words just before an explosion word such as explosive, explosion or exploded, in passages about bombs, TNT, blasts or things going off.

modes.label: Linking words before explosive
modes.description: Words like the, of or high that come right before explosive, explosion or bombs.
modes.example: Even with two hundred pounds of<< high>> explosives, the wave wasn’t large enough

modes.label: Verbs of setting off
modes.description: Verbs or particles like caused, off or going that lead into an explosion or detonation.
modes.example: A deck fire spread to the ammunition magazine for one of the main battery turrets, which<< caused>> a large explosion.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output explosion words such as explosion, explode and explosive.
card.plain: It fires just before the text says something exploded or was explosive.
